card.name: Words leading into continuous infusion
card.fires_on: Small words like by, in, for, a, or continuous just before "infusion" or "bolus" in dosing directions for IV drugs. It marks the spot where the route or style of giving (continuous, slow, bolus) comes next.

modes.label: By before infusion
modes.description: The word "by" introducing a continuous or slow infusion route.

modes.label: Continuous or slow before infusion
modes.description: The modifier "continuous" or "slow" right before "infusion" in how a drug is given.

modes.label: Bolus versus maintenance
modes.description: A linking word in comparisons of bolus and maintenance dosing.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward bolus-like words such as "bol", though the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on the small words right before a drug is said to be given as a continuous drip or a bolus.
